CustomField.description: Minutes an approval waits for a decision, from 1 to 10080 (7 days). Blank uses 1440 (24 hours). With Decided by Policy, a timeout the policy gives for a call replaces this one. Must be blank when Approval is Not Required.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Time allowed for an approval decision, in minutes. Blank uses 1440 (24 hours). The most is 10080 (7 days). With Decided by Policy, the policy may set a different deadline for a call. When the deadline passes, When Approval Expires decides what happens.
CustomField.label: Approval Timeout (Minutes)
